rds.name: Red Dot Sight
rds.shortDescription: A legacy compact red dot sight for quick target acquisition.

rds_makeshift.name: Makeshift Red Dot Sight
rds_makeshift.shortDescription: A 3D printed RDS with a red LED and plastic lens. It is not very reliable, but it works surprising well.

silencer.name: Suppressor
silencer.shortDescription: A simple multi-caliber suppressor that reduces the noise of gunfire, making it harder to detect.

silencer2.name: Night Owl Suppressor
silencer2.shortDescription: A sophisticated multi-caliber suppressor that reduces the noise of gunfire, making it harder to detect.

silencer_makeshift.name: Makeshift Suppressor
silencer_makeshift.shortDescription: A makeshift suppressor made from a plastic bottle and scrap metal.

barrel.name: Attachable Extended Barrel
barrel.shortDescription: A multi-caliber extended barrel that improve bullet velocity and accuracy.

compensator.name: Compensator
compensator.shortDescription: A muzzle device that reduce muzzle rise when firing by redirecting escaping gases

mag_22.name: .22 Magazine
mag_22.shortDescription: A cheap 3D printed 12 round compact .22 magazine.

mag_10mm_smg.name: 10mm SMG Magazine
mag_10mm_smg.shortDescription: A 20 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.

mag_10mm_smg_high.name: 10mm High Capacity SMG Magazine
mag_10mm_smg_high.shortDescription: A 35 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.

mag_10mm_smg_box.name: 10mm SMG Box Magazine
mag_10mm_smg_box.shortDescription: A 150 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.

laser.name: Laser Sight
laser.shortDescription: A simple laser sight that projects a beam onto the target, improving ergonomic.

laser2.name: Target Acquisition Device
laser2.shortDescription: A smart tactical device that projects a beam onto the target based on various conditions.

laser_toy.name: Toy Laser Pointer
laser_toy.shortDescription: A low powered toy laser pointer.

bipod.name: Bipod
bipod.shortDescription: A bipod that can be attached to firearms, providing stability.

stock.name: Guardian Stock
stock.shortDescription: A sturdy stock compatible with Meridian firearms, designed to improve recoil handling.

short_stock.name: Buckler Stock
short_stock.shortDescription: A short stock compatible with Meridian firearms, designed to improve recoil control without sacrificing ergonomic.

internal_springs.name: High Durability Internal Springs
internal_springs.shortDescription: A set of advanced internal springs that improve the cycling and resistance to failure under stress.

internal_springs_improved.name: Improved Internal Springs
internal_springs_improved.shortDescription: A set of sturdier internal springs that help the action cycle reliably.

trigger_group.name: Tuned Trigger Group
trigger_group.shortDescription: A trigger group that improves the trigger pull. Reduces trigger pull weight and creep.

match_barrel.name: Match Grade Barrel
match_barrel.shortDescription: A high precision barrel that improves accuracy.

pistol_switch.name: Pistol Auto Sear
pistol_switch.shortDescription: A special handgun mod. When installed, it alters the internal mechanics so that the gun fires continuously as long as the trigger is held down.

ammo_display.name: Ammo Display
ammo_display.shortDescription: A smart display that shows the current ammo count and ammo type.

grip_gel.name: Tactile Memory Grip Gel
grip_gel.shortDescription: Bio-reactive gel under grip surface conforms subtly to user's hand.
